verdict.rationale: The official CLI lists 'exports' alongside scraping, crawling and schedules. Job definitions such as extract_rules and JS scenarios are plain JSON request parameters, so they are inherently portable, and output can be returned as HTML or markdown. However, there is no documentation of what the export produces, its formats, or any way to export saved schedules or job configurations for migration. Missing for 10: documented export formats for scraped data, export of schedule/job configurations, explicit migration or anti-lock-in guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
